external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in through the identity broker and uses applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague from a franchise store who is vouched for by the franchise identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: franchise stores
external_entities.description: Franchise stores whose colleagues are allowed to sign in through their own identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

external_entities.name: franchise identity provider
external_entities.description: An identity provider controlled by a franchise that vouches for franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The HR system that supplies colleague group-membership changes and leaver changes.
external_entities.source_excerpt: it comes from the HR system overnight

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, accepts franchise identity-provider sign-ins, and provides public signing-key material to applications.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses token group membership to authorize price changes and transaction voids across stores.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker to sign tokens.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory of colleagues and their group memberships.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the identity broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

data_flows.name: use console
data_flows.description: A colleague presents a token to use the store admin console to change prices or void transactions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.data_description: Token containing staff id and group membership; price changes and transaction voids

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: A franchise colleague signs in through the franchise identity provider.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

data_flows.name: vouch
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.notes: The source does not state which colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.
data_flows.data_description: Sign-in assertion for a franchise colleague

data_flows.name: pull changes
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls group-membership and leaver changes from the HR system overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night

data_flows.name: maintain directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker maintains colleague and group-membership data in its directory.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.

data_flows.name: read signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker uses the signing key kept in the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the broker's signing key to check token signatures.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: Public half of the signing key

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: home devices
trust_boundaries.description: Colleagues' own devices at home from which they may sign in.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise-store environment whose colleagues are admitted through an external identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

trust_boundaries.name: franchise identity provider
trust_boundaries.description: The environment controlled by the franchise's own identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

assumptions.assumption: The identity broker is reachable from outside the corporate network because colleagues can sign in from home devices and wherever they are.
assumptions.basis: The description says colleagues sign in to the broker from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

assumptions.assumption: The store admin console presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The component is explicitly named a console, which is treated as a web application interface.

assumptions.assumption: The key store's data is confidential because it holds a signing key.
assumptions.basis: The key store holds the signing key used to sign tokens.

assumptions.assumption: The directory's data is confidential because it holds colleagues and their group memberships.
assumptions.basis: The directory contains colleagues and the groups they are in.
